# Vendor marks

Third-party marks shown as model, provider and tool indicators (which AI runs in a pane, whose usage a pill reports, which editor a menu row opens). They identify the vendor's own product (nominative use) and are not Kolux's marks. None was taken from the old Kolux app or its install folder. Rule (Txais, 2026-10-08): a vendor mark enters this folder only as a file from that vendor's public brand kit, byte-for-byte as supplied (only the file name is changed to say the vendor); nothing is redrawn by hand, and nothing is fetched at run time. `src/marks/registry.ts` is the only code that names these files.

Every file below has its SHA-256 here, taken over the file's text with line ends as LF. `src/marks/registry.test.ts` recomputes each one, so an edited, replaced or unlisted file turns a test red.

Kit downloads were unpacked into a scratch folder outside the repo; only the files above were copied in. The kits' PNG, PDF and wordmark files were left out on purpose (one vector mark per vendor is enough for a 12 to 18 px indicator).
